title: How to play
summary: A slideshow of the rules from the home screen, the leaderboard a tap closer, and a dot on the Shop when a new pack is in.
new: A How to play button on the home screen opens the rules as an animated slideshow, drawn with the game's own stones, cards and tiles
The Shop button wears a gold dot while a pack you haven't seen is on sale
improved: The leaderboard has its own button on the home screen, next to How to play, instead of a place in the menu
fixed: The glow on collection cards at the left and right edges is no longer cut off

title: Two new packs in the shop
summary: Thanos leads the Villains pack and a Mystery Soul pack, cards climb their tiers sooner, and the board takes every tap.
new: The Villains pack added.
The Mystery Soul pack added.
improved: Cards reach each tier after fewer recruits, so a favourite shows its progress sooner
Tapping a card you can't recruit or reserve opens its large view straight away
The leaderboard loads at once, rebuilt as each game ends
fixed: A move tapped while the board was refreshing is played once the refresh is done, instead of being dropped

title: Add to your Home Screen, rejoin your room, and a fair turn clock
summary: iPhone players are shown how to add the game to their Home Screen, a room you're seated in is one tap from home, and the turn timer starts full after a Time Stone or Location.
improved: On an iPhone in the browser, a prompt shows how to add the game to your Home Screen, with a tick to never see it again
With a room waiting, the Private Game tile on the home screen becomes Rejoin your room and goes straight to it
fixed: The turn timer no longer loses the seconds a Time Stone or Location announcement takes: it starts full once the announcement and the Your turn banner have gone
Mister Fantastic's card art

title: Place your picture, who went first, and two leaderboards
summary: Adjust the crop of you PFP (new uploads), and see the leaderboard by rank or by XP.
new: The leaderboard has two tabs, Ranked and XP, each ordered by its own score
improved: The player who went first wears a small gold token on their picture.
A crop button on your picture in Profile settings reopens the frame later, on the full picture you uploaded, so you can place it again

title: New recruits count, and bots get faces
summary: Your first recruit of a character earns XP and shows at the end of the game, bots have pictures, and a bot that goes first is seen going first.
improved: Card XP is simpler: 2 for a first recruit, 5 for every level a card climbs after that
Bots have a picture from the library, never the same as yours or each other's
Recruiting a character for the first time earns XP and appears with the cards that ranked up at the end of the game
fixed: When a bot is picked to go first, you now watch its opening moves instead of landing on a board where it is already your turn

title: The shop opens
summary: Spend your coins on card packs.
new: The shop, from the round button at the bottom left of the home screen: shelves down the side, what's on sale in the middle, and the chosen item with its price and a Buy button
Card packs: a pack's cards are dealt into any game where someone at the table owns it, so you can meet and recruit them even before you buy
improved: A card from a pack you don't own shows locked in your collection, with a way to the shop

title: Random seats, and a closer look at your cards
summary: Seats are dealt at random when a room starts, and a card in your collection opens large with its ranking, count and teams.
improved: Seats are dealt at random when a room's game starts, so the host no longer always goes first
A card tapped in the collection opens large just as it sits in the grid, with its ranking, its count, name and teams beside it, and a button to hide the ranking and see the plain art
fixed: Your reserve or recruit sounds the moment you pick it, not after the server answers

title: Giving back tokens as time runs out
summary: Tapping the tokens to give back is enough: if the clock hits zero before you press the button, your pick still goes through.
fixed: With too many tokens, finishing your pick of what to give back as time runs out now keeps your turn, instead of skipping it with a "time ran out" message

title: Daily bonus, and XP that counts everything
summary: Collect coins every day for an eight-day streak, and earn XP for how you played, not just whether you won.
new: Daily bonus: tap your coins to collect, every day, climbing from 10 coins on Day 1 to 100 on Day 8; miss a day and it starts over
A dot on your coins while today's bonus is waiting
XP for every part of a game: your place, who you played against, points past the target, cards, Avengers badges and tile, Locations and the Time Stone
A tougher table pays more: a human opponent is worth more than a hard bot, and a hard bot more than an easy one
improved: Card levels pay more the further a card climbs, and a hard-to-get Level 3 card climbs sooner than a Level 1
Levels take more XP to reach, so each one means more
Past games have been recounted under the new XP, so your level may have moved
The music is quieter and the sounds a little louder
fixed: A phone changing address mid-visit no longer shows as two visits

title: Sound, feedback, and a new menu
summary: Music and sounds while you play, a way to tell us what you want, and a menu lay out update.
new: Music at the table, and sounds for the moments of a game, WIP.
Music and Sounds switches in the menu and in the game's settings; more sounds are on the way
Feedback from the menu: a feature request, a bug report, or a character you'd like to see
Sign out and delete your account from the menu
improved: The menu layout edit, with round buttons for the leaderboard, what's new and feedback

title: A fuller game log, and no more mid-game sign-outs
summary: Every tile won is in the log, with scores and rounds, and your sign-in no longer runs out during a game.
improved: The log records each Location claimed, the Avengers Assemble tile taken or stolen, and the Time Stone picked up
The move log opens in a larger window and has a bar between rounds
fixed: Players are no longer signed out partway through a game and skipped until a bot takes their seat
If your sign-in does run out, you are signed back in and returned to the board straight away

title: Lobbies that look after themselves
summary: Rooms close if their host leaves, game records stay private, and new players get a hero.
new: A lobby closes if its host leaves and isn't back within 30 seconds, with their seat dimmed and a countdown meanwhile
Private Game takes you straight back to the lobby you are waiting in
A Cancel lobby button for the host
Replay the results screen of any game in your game record, with the rewards it gave
New players start with a random hero picture
improved: The leaderboard shows each player's username, with their level and XP under it
Your game record is only shown to you
fixed: Closing What's new no longer leaves the menu untappable on phones

title: Rewards at the end of a game
summary: See what every game gives you: coins, XP, rank and the cards that ranked up.
new: The results show how each player's rank moved
Your coins, XP and rank count up on the results screen, with a flash when you reach a new level
A full-screen showcase of the cards that ranked up, each flaring into its new tier
XP for every level a card in your collection climbs
improved: The leaderboard is now the rank leaderboard
Every game you have already played shows its rewards

title: Rank, levels and coins
summary: Climb the leaderboard, level up your frames, and earn coins for every game.
new: A rank from games against people, shown on your profile
A leaderboard of the top 100 players by rank
Coins earned for every game played to the end
An account level that grows with every game
Ten gem-cut tier frames, from Bronze up to Mastered, with crystal, twinkle and holographic effects
Level frames on your player card and profile picture, with switches in settings to turn them on
A level frame on every card in your collection, from how often you have recruited it
improved: Coins and level progress shown in the top bar
Every game you have already played counts towards your rank and coins
fixed: What's new in the menu no longer shows a stray outline

title: What's new
summary: See what has changed in the game,
new: An update log in the menu, with every release so far

title: Collections and smarter bots
summary: Collect every card you recruit, and face a tougher hard bot.
new: A collection of every card you have recruited
Sort your collection by level, team or alliance
Past games show the team you built
A hard bot that plans ahead and blocks you
improved: The same top bar on every menu screen
Records only count games against people
fixed: Players removed for being away can no longer rejoin

title: Table chat
summary: Send emojis and quick messages to the table while you play.
new: Emojis and quick messages during a game
A new loading screen for the board
improved: A glow shows whose turn it is
fixed: The turn timer no longer restarts when you make a choice

title: Board animations
summary: The board comes to life, and winning feels like winning.
new: A win screen with falling stones, and Thanos when you lose
Look back at the board after a game ends
An outline shows what each player picked
Locations, the Avengers tile and the Time Stone are announced
improved: Cards glide in and open bigger
fixed: The rule for winning the game
Animations now work in Safari

title: Small fixes
summary: A small fix behind the scenes.
fixed: A small fix behind the scenes

title: Profile pictures
summary: Pick a character as your picture, and see everyone's at the table.
new: Character pictures to choose from for your profile
Each player's picture shows on the board and in the lobby

title: Profiles and the home screen app
summary: Your own profile, and the game on your home screen like an app.
new: Profiles with your stats and every game you've finished
Change your username, name and picture
Add the game to your iPhone's home screen
A game clock you can turn on
A bot fills in for anyone who misses 3 turns
improved: Pictures load faster
A new welcome screen and login page
fixed: No black flash between pages
Lots of small fixes on the board

title: The box-art look
summary: A new look, taken from the game's box art.
new: The box-art look on the board and menus
A new lobby, with a difficulty for each bot

title: Game menu
summary: A menu on the board, and a way to look over your team.
new: A game menu: forfeit, move log and settings
Swipe through the cards you have recruited
Stone art for the tokens you hold
improved: A tidier board that is easier to read
fixed: An error that flashed while the board loaded

title: First release
summary: The game is playable, against the computer or with friends.
new: Play against the computer
Private games with a room code
Made for a phone held on its side
fixed: Players were being logged out by accident
